title: U.P. Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Exam-2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission has announced recruitment for Civil Judge posts under Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2026. Eligible candidates holding a law degree can apply online through the official UPPSC portal.
eligibility_bullets: Candidate must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) from a recognized university.
Must meet the required age limits and guidelines as specified in the official notification.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official UPPSC website at https://uppsc.up.nic.in/
Complete the One Time Registration (OTR) process to generate your OTR number.
Navigate to the candidate dashboard and apply for Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2026.
Fill in all required details, upload documents, and submit the application before the deadline.
